name: Data Lakes & Open Table Formats
description: Modern Data Lake and Lakehouse architecture, object storage (S3, GCS, ADLS), open table formats (Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi), ACID on data lakes, time travel, and file compaction.

subskills.name: Cloud Object Storage & IAM Access Patterns
subskills.description: AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS), storage tiers, lifecycle rules, bucket policies, and high-throughput prefixes.

subskills.name: Columnar File Formats (Parquet, ORC, Avro)
subskills.description: Parquet file anatomy (Header, Data Pages, Column Chunks, Footer/Metadata), dictionary pages, statistics (min/max), and Avro row-based schema.

subskills.name: Delta Lake & Transaction Logs
subskills.description: Delta Lake ACID transactions, _delta_log JSON transaction log, checkpoint parquet files, optimistic concurrency control, and merge operations.

subskills.name: Apache Iceberg Open Table Format
subskills.description: Iceberg architecture: Iceberg Catalog, Metadata File (JSON), Manifest List (Avro), Manifest Files (Avro), data files, snapshot isolation, and hidden partitioning.

subskills.name: Apache Hudi & Upsert Architecture
subskills.description: Hudi Copy-on-Write (CoW) vs Merge-on-Read (MoR), timeline metadata, key-based record indexing, file sizing, and incremental data consumption.

subskills.name: Data Skipping, Partitioning & Z-Ordering
subskills.description: Multi-dimensional clustering with Z-Order Curves, Hilbert curves, partition pruning, min/max file skipping, and avoiding over-partitioning.

subskills.name: Small File Problem & Automated Compaction
subskills.description: Mitigating the small files problem in streaming/batch ingest, bin-packing, OPTIMIZE compaction jobs, and maintenance procedures.

subskills.name: Medallion Architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold)
subskills.description: Designing Bronze (raw, append-only), Silver (cleaned, deduplicated, enriched), and Gold (aggregated, business-level dimensional) lakehouse layers.

subskills.name: Time Travel, Rollback & Schema Evolution
subskills.description: Querying historical snapshots (TIMESTAMP AS OF / VERSION AS OF), rollbacks, additive vs breaking schema changes, and column renaming.

cv.signal: Built enterprise Lakehouse using Delta Lake and Apache Iceberg with Medallion architecture

linkedin.signal: Hands-on experience with Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and AWS S3 storage

assessment.signal: Passes Data Lakes & Open Table Formats Technical Assessment

junior.description: Interacts with cloud object storage, writes optimized Parquet datasets, and organizes data along Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) stages.

mid.description: Implements ACID table formats (Delta/Iceberg), manages snapshot isolation, time travel queries, and configures Z-ordering.

senior.description: Architects high-throughput lakehouse upserts with Hudi/Iceberg, designs automated compaction strategies, and governs lakehouse metadata integrity.
